reasoning_traces.think:
The core thesis posits that consciousness is not an object of scientific study but rather a functional aspect of behavior. This aligns with a dualistic framework where raw feels are epistemologically inaccessible. Functionally, ideation serves to amplify weak signals—sign-gestalts—into dominant behavioral determinants. The mathematical lens is thus one of functionalism: consciousness is defined by its role in behavior, not its intrinsic nature. In Bayesian terms, ideation updates belief states by reinforcing weak priors. The exclusion of raw feels ensures that models remain computationally tractable and empirically verifiable. The breakdown regime arises when subjective experience intrudes into objective modeling, leading to inconsistency. The GSI mapping reflects this as a probabilistic update process, while GSE maps it to dynamic state transitions triggered by cognitive reinforcement.
